$schema_note: MooterBench dataset v0.1.0 — 50 representative coding workflows. expected_tier follows the Mooter routing doctrine: T0 trivial/local, T1 cheap codegen/triage, T2 reasoning/bug-hunt, T3 architecture/multi-file/high-risk. Labels are author-judgment gold labels, not ground truth.

workflows.prompt: the websocket connection drops every few minutes in production but reconnect only works sometimes — figure out why

workflows.prompt: users report the cart total is off by one cent on some orders; trace where the rounding goes wrong

workflows.prompt: memory usage climbs steadily in the image-resize service until the pod is OOM-killed; find the leak

workflows.prompt: why does the login flow work in Chrome but redirect-loop in Safari? dig into the cookie/session handling

workflows.prompt: our search endpoint p95 latency doubled after last week's deploy with no obvious slow query; profile and explain what regressed

workflows.prompt: should we replace moment.js with date-fns or Temporal? lay out migration effort and bundle impact for each

workflows.prompt: evaluate whether upgrading from Express 4 to 5 breaks any of our middleware, and list what needs changing

workflows.prompt: pick a queue library for delayed jobs on our Node monolith — BullMQ vs bee-queue vs pg-boss — and justify the choice

workflows.prompt: write property-based tests for the rate limiter that prove no more than N requests pass per window under concurrent access
